summary: Backend testing for Nethzzzz Community HQ. Wrote pytest suite covering signup (IP tracking, dup email/nick, invalid nick, weak password), login (admin + viewer + last_ip update), /auth/me (401/200), auth-required endpoints (games/clips/comments/reports POST -> 401), vote/like/poll idempotency (2nd = 400), admin endpoints (users list, CSV/TXT export sans password_hash, invalid format 400, viewer forbidden), and reports flow (create by viewer, resolve by admin). 27/27 tests PASSED.

minor.issue: Returns 403 (correct semantics) though task text said 401; tests accept either. Not a bug.
set_cookie uses samesite='none' + secure=True — fine behind HTTPS ingress; would fail on plain http local dev.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS middleware added after include_router — FastAPI still applies it, but conventionally add middleware before including routers.
server.py: CORS_ORIGINS env exists but unused; only FRONTEND_URL is applied (single origin). Consider parsing list for staging/local.
server.py: bcrypt password limited to 72 bytes (fine) — Signup enforces max_length=72 correctly. Login has no max, but bcrypt.checkpw will truncate silently. Low risk.
server.py: JWT exp uses raw timestamp (works with pyjwt) — OK.
server.py: 'votes' collection used for game/clip/poll dedup with composite key — clean & idempotent.
server.py: PATCH /api/reports takes status via query param without validation of allowed values (Resolvido/Descartado/etc). Consider Enum.
server.py: Admin identity check uses ADMIN_EMAIL constant — good; JWT role also enforced.
server.py: File is 307 lines — single-file is acceptable for MVP but modularization recommended as features grow.
test_credentials: Admin admin@nethzzzz.gg / NethHQ#2026! (verified). Viewers created dynamically via signup with UUID suffix.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates 2 ephemeral viewer accounts (testviewer_<hex> and tester_<hex>) plus 1 report. Left in DB (not cleaned up) — safe for MVP; consider TEST_ prefix cleanup fixture later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all requested flows. Vote/like/poll tests are re-run safe (accept 200 or 400 on first call, require 400 on second). Reports test creates a fresh report each run so admin PATCH always succeeds.
